text.p: Leading stories in the Greek financial press:
-- Harder drachma in 1997 according to officials at the finance and national economy ministries. Forex inflows continue
-- Tax objective criteria will bring in revenues estimated at 200 billion drachmas in 1997. The bases on which objective criteria are calculated will be adjusted upwards for the self-employed
-- Tax authorities will pull out and take a second look at 1.0 million files. The goal is to collect back taxes and penalties
-- Construction of 200 public works is accelerated to absorb 500 billion drachmas from the EU
-- EU convergence starts with pay hikes of 10 percent. The new pay scale of civil servants is exempted from the "tough" measures
-- New sources of revenues from penalties and the elimination of tax breaks
